name: Research computing consultation
blurb: One 90-minute remote session, review of a short brief, and a written action plan. For a research AI idea, model choice, or HPC architecture question.

name: HPC / AI troubleshooting
blurb: Up to four engineering hours on one reproducible issue in one agreed environment. Evidence review, diagnosis, and a written repair plan; approved low-risk fixes within the time cap.

name: HPC performance assessment
blurb: Up to 12 engineering hours on one workload and one cluster. Scheduler, GPU/CPU, storage and fabric profiling, a baseline, and prioritized findings. Implementation quoted separately.

name: Research AI model evaluation
blurb: Up to eight engineering hours comparing up to three candidate models on one agreed task and a client-supplied evaluation set. Quality, latency and cost comparison with a recommendation.

name: GPU / workflow optimization sprint
blurb: Projects from $6,000. One agreed performance bottleneck or workflow, implementation, before-and-after measurements, and handover. Final scope, effort and fee are quoted.

name: Research AI application or pipeline
blurb: Projects from $9,500. A scoped application, RAG assistant, scientific data pipeline or model integration with evaluation and handover. Data readiness and integrations determine the final quote.

name: Research engineering support
blurb: $300 per hour, four-hour minimum ($1,200), with an agreed spending cap. Scheduled support, workflow maintenance, or team enablement. No automatic renewal or round-the-clock response promise.
